name: Let there be chaos
author: Zhiu_1234
description:
This is my entry of Brackeys Game Jam 2021.2. The theme was "Let there be chaos". I always envied my cat destroying my furniture and throwing around all sorts of things that are laying around, so I decided to make a game to live the dream of breaking havoc as a cat! Controls are simple:

WASD or arrow keys move the cat
Mouse controls the camera
'h' will open/close the help
'q' will quit the game after reaching the story goal
I hope you enjoy it. :)
